verdict.rationale: The only evidence that RunAnywhere installs through a standard package manager comes from community reports, which mention a Homebrew install path for rcli. Those same reports say the install is unreliable: not everything loads properly via Homebrew, and the install script itself installs Brew. Missing for 10: first-party install docs for any package manager (Homebrew, SPM, Gradle/Maven, npm), SDK package coordinates, evidence that installation is quick and reliable, and independent confirmation of a working install.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager

citations.quote: not everything loads properly when installed via homebrew
